rationale: The workflow already implements P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE via its existing concurrency block (group: build, cancel-in-progress: true), so no change is needed there. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (bound jobs with a custom timeout) is the next most relevant pattern and has measured evidence, but its precondition—representative successful-duration history—is not met: the repository CI history contains only failed runs (3 failures, no successes), so a safe timeout budget cannot be derived. Applying the evidence's 5-minute timeout to this macOS Xcode/fastlane workflow (checkout, bundle install, brew install xcbeautify, xcodebuild, fastlane unit_tests) risks violating the contraindication that valid slow runs exceed the proposed limit, potentially turning passing builds into timeout failures. No matrix exists for P-LIT-FAIL-FAST, and dependency caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) lacks verified cache inputs and could introduce mutable cached content without a measured baseline. Preserving existing build/test coverage, no supported optimization is safe to apply.
